title: Left on the Step  (Déposée sur la marche)

segments.t: Il est presque neuf heures du soir et les lanternes de la cour diffusent une lueur douce tandis que Hannah achève sa première journée auprès de Graham. Soudain, la cloche du portail tinte une fois dans le calme nocturne. Écoutez d'abord.
Did you hear that, Graham? Someone just rang the gate bell!
At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.
Hello? Good evening! Nobody is standing at the gate!
Wait. Look down on the stone step.
Another dark blue suitcase! Is this Miss Evelyn's bag?
Check the zipper... yes, her initials are right here!
Why did the person run away without taking his own suitcase back?
Look, there is a folded white envelope taped to the handle.
Let me read it: 'Sorry for the mistake. Please keep my blue bag until Friday.'
Until Friday? No name, no signature!
Why leave your own shoes and wooden train with strangers until Friday?
Welcome to the Linden Courtyard Inn, Hannah. Your second day will not be boring.
Reprenons ensemble chaque phrase de ce final d'épisode.
Did you hear that, Graham? Someone just rang the gate bell!
'Tu as entendu ça, Graham? Quelqu'un vient de sonner au portail!'
At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.
'À neuf heures? Attendez, ouvrons le portail ensemble.'
Hello? Good evening! Nobody is standing at the gate!
'Allô? Bonsoir! Il n'y a personne au portail!'
Wait. Look down on the stone step.
'Attends. Regarde en bas sur la marche en pierre.'
Another dark blue suitcase! Is this Miss Evelyn's bag?
'Encore une valise bleu marine! Est-ce le sac de Mademoiselle Evelyn?'
Check the zipper... yes, her initials are right here!
'Vérifie la fermeture éclair... oui, ses initiales sont juste là!'
Why did the person run away without taking his own suitcase back?
'Pourquoi cette personne s'est-elle enfuie sans reprendre sa propre valise?'
Look, there is a folded white envelope taped to the handle.
'Regarde, il y a une enveloppe blanche pliée scotchée à la poignée.'
Let me read it: 'Sorry for the mistake. Please keep my blue bag until Friday.'
'Laisse-moi la lire: "Désolé pour l'erreur. Veuillez garder mon sac bleu jusqu'à vendredi."'
Until Friday? No name, no signature!
'Jusqu'à vendredi? Ni nom, ni signature!'
Why leave your own shoes and wooden train with strangers until Friday?
'Pourquoi laisser ses propres chaussures et son train en bois chez des inconnus jusqu'à vendredi?'
Welcome to the Linden Courtyard Inn, Hannah. Your second day will not be boring.
'Bienvenue à l'Auberge de la Cour du Tilleul, Hannah. Ta deuxième journée ne sera pas ennuyeuse.'
Réécoutons une dernière fois toute la scène à allure naturelle.
Did you hear that, Graham? Someone just rang the gate bell!
At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.
Hello? Good evening! Nobody is standing at the gate!
Wait. Look down on the stone step.
Another dark blue suitcase! Is this Miss Evelyn's bag?
Check the zipper... yes, her initials are right here!
Why did the person run away without taking his own suitcase back?
Look, there is a folded white envelope taped to the handle.
Let me read it: 'Sorry for the mistake. Please keep my blue bag until Friday.'
Until Friday? No name, no signature!
Why leave your own shoes and wooden train with strangers until Friday?
Welcome to the Linden Courtyard Inn, Hannah. Your second day will not be boring.

La valise d'Evelyn est revenue, mais l'inconnu s'est volatilisé dans la nuit en demandant qu'on garde la sienne jusqu'à vendredi. Ainsi s'achève le premier épisode; rendez-vous au deuxième épisode! À très bientôt!
Have a good night!
